description: Async Rust client library for the Frontal API, with reqwest transport, typed models, service clients, and optional SSE streaming.
rules: The published crate is named frontal and uses Rust 2021 with MSRV 1.75.
Use contracts/sdk-endpoints.json and contracts/openapi as the source of truth for endpoint methods and paths.
Keep shared transport and request behavior in src/api, models in src/models, and service handles in src/resources.
The default feature enables all service namespaces; SSE support is enabled by the stream feature.
Use Result for fallible operations and keep internal helpers private unless intentionally public.
